subject: general
question: Indian Industrialists reacted against colonial policies that restricted business activities and formed an organisation in 1927. What was it called?

options.text: Federation of the Indian Chamber of Commerce and Industries (FICCI)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Federation of the Indian Chamber of Commerce and Industries (FICCI)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Federation of the Indian Chamber of Commerce and Industries (FICCI) was formed in 1927.
 
• Indian industrialists formed FICCI in response to colonial policies that restricted business activities in India.
 
• FICCI played a significant role in lobbying for economic reforms and the interests of Indian businesses during the colonial period.
 
• It remains one of the largest and oldest business organizations in India, representing various sectors of Indian industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The formation of FICCI was spearheaded by prominent Indian industrialists such as G.D. Birla and Purshottamdas Thakurdas.
 
• FICCI has been instrumental in shaping the economic and industrial policies of India post-independence.
 
• It continues to work towards fostering economic growth and enhancing the global competitiveness of Indian industries.
 
• FICCI organizes various events, conferences, and forums to facilitate dialogue between the government and industry stakeholders.
 
• It also provides a platform for businesses to collaborate and share best practices.
